_comment: LIVE TRADING CONFIGURATION - Copy to live_trading_config.json and customize
comment_enabled: Set to true to activate live trading globally

live_trading_conditions.comment: Both conditions must be true: Model B >= 90 AND vol_ratio >= 1.5

accounts.name: Primary
accounts.comment_enabled: Set to true to enable this account
accounts.comment_env_vars: These env vars are set in .env file
accounts.comment_capital: max_capital: total capital available, max_positions: max open positions, max_alloc_per_trade: ₹ per trade

risk_controls.comment_daily_loss: Max % daily loss across all accounts
risk_controls.comment_sector: Max 1 position per sector per account

notifications.comment_whatsapp: Send WhatsApp notifications on live orders (requires Twilio setup)

comment_dry_run: Set to true to validate orders without submitting to Angel One

example_workflow.step_1_test: Set dry_run: true, run bot, check live_trading.log for [DRY RUN] messages
example_workflow.step_2_secondary: Set enabled: true, account[Secondary].enabled: true, run for 1 week
example_workflow.step_3_primary: Set account[Primary].enabled: true, run for 1 week, verify P&L
example_workflow.step_4_optimize: Adjust model_b_min (90-95), vol_ratio_min (1.5-2.0) based on results
